newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Atlas Copco 9-mo profit up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Atlas Copco 9-mo profit up 8 pct.

text.p: Swedish engineering group Atlas Copco is expected to post an eight percent increase in nine month profits at 2.22 billion crowns after financial net, a poll of 13 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from 2.13 billion crowns to 2.30 billion.
For full year 1996 analysts' average forecast was for a profit after net financial items of 2.98 billion crowns compared with 2.84 billion in 1995.
The forecasts indicated a rise in sales in the first nine months to 18.45 billion crowns against 17.77 billion in the same period last year.
Atlas Copco's sales were judged to rise to 25.29 billion for the full year against 24.45 billion in 1995.
Atlas Copco reports nine-month results on November 21.
Sources: Aros, Den Danske Bank, Erik Penser, Fischer Partners, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Lehman Brothers, Matteus, Morgan Grenfell, Morgan Stanley, Swedbank, UBS, Ohman.
